fact: In the fourth quarter of 2021 DHIS2 was in use in all 34 health zones of Sud-Kivu, where health centres, health posts and general referral hospitals send paper reports to the health zone office (BCZ) for encoding into DHIS2; a nurses' strike from mid-July 2021 stopped that transmission and provincial completeness for basic services fell to 63% in October and 41% in November.
title: Rapport sur la fonctionnalité du logiciel DHIS2 dans la province du Sud-Kivu au quatrième trimestre 2021
publisher: Division Provinciale de la Santé du Sud-Kivu, Ministère de la Santé Publique
